> Intended to assist a human reviewer, not replace one — suggestions may be
> incorrect, please verify before acting.


The new endpoint is minimal and follows existing handler/response patterns (the 403-via-middleware, 404, and 422 paths are all covered by tests and the ValidationException→422 mapping is confirmed). Two substantive concerns: (1) the endpoint authenticates the client cert but never authorizes it — the RequireClientCertMiddleware only stores request.scope["client_cn"] and no handler compares it against {system_id}, so any enrolled agent can enumerate another rack controller's DHCP/network configuration; (2) the wire contract is built directly on service-layer stdlib dataclasses (VlanData/SubnetData/…), so the public JSON schema is coupled to internal DTO renames. Minor: one line exceeds the project's 79-char width.

src/maasapiserver/v3/api/internal/handle.212: Authorization gap: RequireClientCertMiddleware only checks that a client_cn exists (see v3/middlewares/client_certificate.py:38) and stores it in request.scope, but it is never compared to {system_id}. Any enrolled agent can GET /agents/<other-system-id>/dhcp-data and read another rack's subnets, DNS/ntp servers, gateway IPs and HA peer IPs. Consider binding the scope CN to system_id here (or in the middleware) before returning cross-controller DHCP data.
src/maasapiserver/v3/api/internal/handle.215: Style: this line is 89 characters, exceeding the 79-char width configured in pyproject.toml ([tool.ruff] line-length = 79). E501 is ignored by lint, but AGENTS.md requires 79 chars.

src/maasapiserver/v3/api/internal/models.73: Maintainability: the response fields reuse service-layer DTOs (VlanData, SubnetData, IPRangeData, InterfaceData, KeaHAConfig) directly. This couples the public API/JSON contract to internal maasservicelayer dataclasses — renaming any DTO field silently changes the wire schema. Other responses (e.g. interfaces.py LinkResponse) define their own Pydantic response types; consider mirroring that here.
